Estimates of non-Acropora hard corals and encrusting soft corals were comparable across methods. ReefScan underestimated total hard coral cover relative to diver photo-transects. Traditional Owners chose ReefScan for regional assessments.
controlled observational.

Images from SCUBA photo-transects, vessel-deployed drop cameras and transom-mounted ReefScan units were analyzed with machine-learning models. The methods were compared statistically on the cover of six benthic groups. Traditional Owners gave structured feedback on each method.
